knownContractConflicts.description: Frontier inherited FB2-49 lifecycle/server-authority semantics overlap the main integration repair. These identities cannot be replayed as MIGRATION_ONLY until parity is revalidated.

Four Lostbelt objective identities are in the stacked formal ledger but absent from R123 material; the sync report claims fresh R66 acceptance, while PR #372 has no reviewer comment/review and no independent reviewer report is present.
M50-01/M50-02 batch acceptance is preserved as evidence, but current-main replay must be identity/semantic-contract based rather than replaying either 50-skill macro wholesale.

suggestedReplayBatches.name: Evidence recovery / ledger repair
suggestedReplayBatches.scope: Recover independent reviewer evidence or re-review only where governance permits; includes historical PRs #356/#359/#361/#363/#364/#366/#368/#372. Do not semantic-replay until evidence is repaired.

suggestedReplayBatches.name: FB2-49 contract parity
suggestedReplayBatches.scope: Establish new-main lifecycle/authority parity after #424 before replay.

suggestedReplayBatches.name: Outer God Life subsystem
suggestedReplayBatches.scope: Replay/revalidate the generic Outer-God-Life runtime contract first, then the five consumer definitions.

suggestedReplayBatches.name: Generic runtime semantic replay
suggestedReplayBatches.scope: Group by accepted contract/runtime primitive and shared hot-file dependency, not by historical PR chronology. Re-establish capability on current main before consumer migration.

suggestedReplayBatches.name: Migration-only
suggestedReplayBatches.scope: Candidate for direct source migration only after current-main contract/test/reviewer evidence is rechecked.

suggestedReplayBatches.name: M50 semantic decomposition
suggestedReplayBatches.scope: Decompose the 100 historical M50 material identities by normalized semantic contract / requiredCapabilities / referenceHandlerId; never replay M50-01 or M50-02 as a 50-card unit.

openQuestions: Can missing independent reviewer evidence for PRs #356/#359/#361/#363/#364/#366/#368/#372 be recovered from an external reviewer channel not present in GitHub/repo history?
Should the four R66 Lostbelt objective identities be re-materialized only after reviewer-evidence repair, or re-reviewed under current promotion governance?
Which M50 identity-level semantic groups are already equivalent to current main after governance/integration work, versus requiring replay?
What exact FB2-49 semantic parity is established once PR #424 is promoted, especially for Astolfo and the M50-02 Scathach single-opponent extension?
